nodes.summary: There is no injective group homomorphism from the braid group $B_4$ on four strands to the automorphism group $\operatorname{Aut}(F_2)$ of the free group $F_2$ of rank $2$. Kourovka Problem 17.14 (V. G. Bardakov) asks whether, for $n \ge 4$, the braid group $B_n$ embeds in the automorphism group of the free group $F_{n-2}$ of rank $n - 2$; this answers the case $n = 4$ negatively.
nodes.title: Bardakov–Bellingeri: $B_4$ does not embed in $\operatorname{Aut}(F_2)$

nodes.summary: The statement that there is an injective group homomorphism from the braid group $B_4$ on four strands to the automorphism group $\operatorname{Aut}(F_2)$ of the free group $F_2$ of rank $2$. Kourovka Problem 17.14 (V. G. Bardakov) asks whether, for $n \ge 4$, the braid group $B_n$ embeds in the automorphism group of the free group $F_{n-2}$ of rank $n - 2$; this is the case $n = 4$.
nodes.title: Bardakov's question on embedding $B_4$ in $\operatorname{Aut}(F_2)$

nodes.summary: The braid group on four strands, given by Artin's presentation: the group generated by $\sigma_1, \sigma_2, \sigma_3$ subject to the relations $\sigma_1 \sigma_2 \sigma_1 = \sigma_2 \sigma_1 \sigma_2$, $\sigma_2 \sigma_3 \sigma_2 = \sigma_3 \sigma_2 \sigma_3$ and $\sigma_1 \sigma_3 = \sigma_3 \sigma_1$.
